about: Answers to an ending question as the back end writes them: the finished cover and what streams (tests/test_ending_question_cover.py). The screen test (MainTabChatTranscript.endingCover.test.tsx) draws these same strings.

cases.question: How does Hollow Knight end?
cases.model_text:

The story then concludes with the player ascending to the Light.
